tagline: 佳能取景器相机，1989 年发布
description: 佳能于1989年推出的取景器相机。快门速度1/45, 1/60, and 1/250s.。

specs.英文简介: The Canon Snappy V (Prima Junior Hi in Europe) of November 1989 was a compact camera for budget-conscious photographers, and was part of the Canon Snappy series.
